entities.note: 3x3 square with a colour-14 border and a BLACK(0) centre = the selected block, at rows 30-32, cols 18-20 (on the left room's floor, just left of the bridge); moves 3 px per press

identical 3x3 colour-14 square with a colour-5 centre (never selected yet) at rows 30-32, cols 27-29 on the bridge; it is pushed by the controlled block and can be made the controlled one by clicking it (centre turns 0; the deselected block's centre turns colour 4)

hollow 5x5 colour-4 frames with a 3x3 cavity: rows 32-36, cols 11-15 (left room) and rows 26-30, cols 44-48 (right room); a block fits when it sits exactly in the cavity (rows 33-35 cols 12-14 / rows 27-29 cols 45-47)

colour-15 vertical strip rows 21-41, cols 33-38 splitting the floor: the controlled block can never enter it, but a PUSHED block slides across it (a push keeps going until the block is clear of the strip)
colour-1 floor: left room rows 21-41 cols 9-23, a one-block-high bridge rows 30-32 cols 24-32, and the right room rows 21-41 cols 39-53 beyond the pit; blocks move on a 3-px lattice
colour 2 everywhere else (letterbox rows 0-20/42-62, cols 0-8/54-63 and the notches above and below the bridge): impassable for every block
row 63: colour 4 = remaining steps, black(0) eats in from the RIGHT (64 px = 100 steps, about 0.64 px per action); every action including clicks costs 1

rules.note: selected block up 3 px; costs 1 step
a move that would overlap colour-2 wall or the colour-15 pit is refused; the step is still spent (same for ACTION2/3/4)

moving into the other block: the selected block STAYS PUT and the other block shoots 5 cells (15 px) in that direction, 3 px per frame, stopping early at a wall and continuing past 15 px if it would otherwise stop over the pit (so from the bridge it lands in the right room at rows 30-32 cols 42-44); the pusher's leading edge flashes colour 14 (same for ACTION1/2/3)
clicking any block makes it the one the arrows move: its centre turns black(0) and the previously selected block's centre turns colour 4; costs 1 step
clicking floor, wall, pit or a socket changes nothing but still costs 1 step

goal.note: both colour-14 blocks must sit exactly inside the two colour-4 frames at the same time (checked after every action): the bridge block has to be pushed across the pit, then clicked and steered into the right socket; minimal 11 actions
